summary: The nightshift-payments Lambda function was throttled due to insufficient reserved concurrency (set to 2). A traffic spike (164 invocations in one minute) exceeded this limit, causing throttling events. No errors or misconfigurations were found in logs or deployments.
proposed_actions: Increase the reserved concurrency for the nightshift-payments Lambda function to handle expected traffic loads.
Investigate the cause of the traffic spike to prevent future throttling.
